_doc: Hand-annotated layout of the fixed camera view, in 1920x1080 reference pixels. Read from outputs/frames/ref_C3896.png. The organizers provide no camera.md, so this file is our own.

upper._doc: far carriageway, above the median; traffic moves away from the camera (towards top-left)

lower._doc: near carriageway, below the median; traffic moves towards the camera (towards bottom-right)
white stop line before crosswalk A; vehicles cross it moving down-right

upper._doc: no painted line visible; the near edge of crosswalk B is used. Its signal faces away from the camera: in every sample more vehicles cross here while 'main' is red than green, so the visible light does not control it

main._doc: 3-lamp vehicle signal on the median facing the camera. The lower carriageway runs in phase with it (in the samples ~99% of its stop-line crossings happen on green); the upper carriageway does not

side._doc: 2-lamp signal on the bottom-left pole, facing the camera; in phase with main in every sample (backup when main is occluded)

parking._doc: roadside parking pocket on the left edge: cars stand here for minutes and people walk to them; not an event

non_carriageway._doc: raised areas inside the road where vehicles cannot be and pedestrians are allowed
